panels.title: Pilots online now (in region)
panels.description: v1 card 68. Pilots inside the Australian boundary polygon in the newest snapshot (network_snapshot.pilots_in_region).

targets.rawSql: SELECT pilots_in_region AS "Pilots" FROM network_history ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Pilots online now (network-wide)
panels.description: All pilots on the VATSIM network in the newest snapshot (network_snapshot.pilots_global). New panel; context for the in-region figure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pilots_global AS "Pilots" FROM network_history ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Pilots online over time
panels.description: Screenshot-only chart (pilots online over time). Pilots in region and network-wide per snapshot, averaged into buckets that follow the dashboard range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(observed_at, $__interval),
       avg(pilots_in_region) AS "In region",
       avg(pilots_global) AS "Network-wide"
FROM network_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: When are people online on weekdays (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 94. For each UTC clock hour, the number of distinct callsigns online at some point in that hour, over the last 30 days: pilots (flights with airborne time) and ATC (sessions of at least 20 minutes). Monday to Friday (v1 used Sunday, Monday and Saturday as a data workaround). Flights and sessions that cross midnight wrap into the early hours. This is a count over the whole period, not an average of concurrent users.

targets.rawSql:
-- v1 card 94: callsigns online in each UTC clock hour over the last 30 days.
WITH flight_hours AS (
    SELECT f.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int >= EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int + 24 END
           ) % 24 AS active_hour
    FROM flight f
    WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
      AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') BETWEEN 1 AND 5
      AND f.logon_time IS NOT NULL
      AND f.end_time IS NOT NULL
),
atc_hours AS (
    SELECT cs.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int >= EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int + 24 END
           ) % 24 AS active_hour
    FROM controller_summaries cs
    WHERE (cs.session_start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
           OR cs.session_end_time >= now() - interval '30 days')
      AND cs.session_duration_minutes >= 20
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') BETWEEN 1 AND 5
      AND cs.session_start_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(fh.active_hour, ah.active_hour)::int AS hour_utc,
       COALESCE(fh.n, 0) AS "Pilots (callsigns)",
       COALESCE(ah.n, 0) AS "ATC (callsigns)"
FROM (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM flight_hours GROUP BY active_hour) fh
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM atc_hours GROUP BY active_hour) ah
  ON fh.active_hour = ah.active_hour
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: When are people online on weekends (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 95. For each UTC clock hour, the number of distinct callsigns online at some point in that hour, over the last 30 days: pilots (flights with airborne time) and ATC (sessions of at least 30 minutes). Saturday and Sunday. As in v1, a flight or session that crosses midnight is not counted for the hours after midnight (v1 quirk kept). This is a count over the whole period, not an average of concurrent users.

targets.rawSql:
-- v1 card 95: callsigns online in each UTC clock hour over the last 30 days.
WITH flight_hours AS (
    SELECT f.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int
           ) AS active_hour
    FROM flight f
    WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
      AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') IN (6, 7)
      AND f.logon_time IS NOT NULL
      AND f.end_time IS NOT NULL
),
atc_hours AS (
    SELECT cs.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int
           ) AS active_hour
    FROM controller_summaries cs
    WHERE (cs.session_start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
           OR cs.session_end_time >= now() - interval '30 days')
      AND cs.session_duration_minutes >= 30
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') IN (6, 7)
      AND cs.session_start_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(fh.active_hour, ah.active_hour)::int AS hour_utc,
       COALESCE(fh.n, 0) AS "Pilots (callsigns)",
       COALESCE(ah.n, 0) AS "ATC (callsigns)"
FROM (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM flight_hours GROUP BY active_hour) fh
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM atc_hours GROUP BY active_hour) ah
  ON fh.active_hour = ah.active_hour
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Departure board
panels.description: v1 card 138. Pilots whose flight plan departs Sydney (YSSY) and who were seen in the last 3 hours, newest first within status. Changed from v1: no invented gate or 'ON TIME' columns; status is derived from ground speed (60 kt or more = airborne, the same threshold as airborne minutes).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign AS "Flight",
       COALESCE(arrival, 'N/A') AS "Destination",
       status AS "Status",
       COALESCE(deptime, 'N/A') AS "Planned departure (UTC)",
       gs_kt AS "Speed (kt)",
       alt_ft AS "Altitude (ft)",
       COALESCE(flight_rules, 'N/A') AS "Rules",
       COALESCE(aircraft_icao, 'N/A') AS "Aircraft",
       last_seen AS "Last seen"
FROM (
  SELECT l.*,
         CASE WHEN NOT l.is_online THEN 'LOGGED OFF'
              WHEN l.gs_kt >= 60 THEN 'AIRBORNE'
              WHEN l.gs_kt > 0 THEN 'TAXIING'
              WHEN l.gs_kt = 0 THEN 'ON GROUND'
              ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS status,
         CASE WHEN NOT l.is_online THEN 5
              WHEN l.gs_kt >= 60 THEN 4
              WHEN l.gs_kt > 0 THEN 3
              WHEN l.gs_kt = 0 THEN 1
              ELSE 6 END AS status_rank
  FROM pilot_latest l
  WHERE l.departure = 'YSSY'
) b
ORDER BY status_rank, last_seen DESC
LIMIT 25
